why.en: If you run WireGuard yourself, this shows peers, last handshake time and transfer counters.
why.hinglish: Agar aap khud WireGuard chalate ho, to yeh peers, last handshake time aur transfer counters dikhata hai.

expect.en: Needs WireGuard installed and a tunnel up; otherwise the command is not found or prints nothing. You see each peer's public key, endpoint, allowed ips, 'latest handshake: N seconds ago' (stays under about 2 minutes while active) and bytes sent and received. Output varies.
expect.hinglish: WireGuard install aur tunnel up hona chahiye; warna command nahi milti ya kuch print nahi karti. Har peer ki public key, endpoint, allowed ips, 'latest handshake: N seconds ago' (active rehte hue lagbhag 2 minutes se kam) aur bytes sent aur received dikhte hain. Output alag ho sakta hai.

why.en: Ping a host on the far side of your own tunnel to see traffic going through it.
why.hinglish: Apne tunnel ke doosri taraf ke host ko ping karo taaki traffic tunnel se jaata dikhe.

expect.en: The address 10.20.0.5 is the lesson's example NAS; use a host on your own network. With the tunnel up you get replies; with it down you get timeouts. The first packet can be slower because it triggers the handshake.
expect.hinglish: Address 10.20.0.5 lesson ka example NAS hai; apne network ka host use karo. Tunnel up ho to replies milte hain; down ho to timeouts. Pehla packet slow ho sakta hai kyunki woh handshake trigger karta hai.

title.en: See WireGuard packets in the capture

why.en: Open the downloaded .pcap and look at the four message types.
why.hinglish: Download kiya .pcap kholo aur chaaron message types dekho.

expect.en: You see Handshake Initiation (type 1), Handshake Response (type 2) and Transport Data (type 4) packets on UDP 51820. Only the headers are readable; the payload is encrypted.
expect.hinglish: UDP 51820 par Handshake Initiation (type 1), Handshake Response (type 2) aur Transport Data (type 4) packets dikhte hain. Sirf headers padhne laayak hain; payload encrypted hai.

why.en: Filters the type 3 messages from the under-load scenario.
why.hinglish: Under-load scenario ke type 3 messages filter karta hai.

expect.en: In the cookie scenario capture you see 64-byte Cookie Reply packets; in the normal capture there are none.
expect.hinglish: Cookie scenario ke capture mein 64-byte Cookie Reply packets dikhte hain; normal capture mein koi nahi hota.
